trainingSelection: Ultralytics best checkpoint by VAL mAP50-95; max 150 epochs, early stopping after 20 epochs without improvement. Full-network fine-tune, not only the head.
runtimeSelection: VAL only: confidence 0.15,0.25,0.35,0.45, trafficMode legacy or body; 0.7*macroF1+0.3*balanced signal recall INCLUDING misses. Require observed falseGreen=0 and no more than 21 traffic-FP frames and 1 specific-colour FP box on the already-reviewed 98-frame VAL shoe clip. Historical baseline/improved included as controls; no tuning on TEST.
testProtocol: TEST is a previously reused benchmark, not a blind holdout. Choose and freeze weights/profile on VAL before computing the new TEST results. No test-based model or threshold selection.
deployment: Never replace production weights or enable motors; bench-only candidate until robot validation.

continuation.reason: Correct one enlarged-review TRAIN coordinate, reset optimizer after warm-start from VAL best; lower LR for full-network refinement. No TEST consumed/used to decide this.
